Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

A Rose Dragon Egg can be purchased from Ludleth. The Rose Dragon Egg costs 500,000,000 Coins, 20,000 Copper,  5x Condensed Helianthus,  1x Glasscorn,  1x Devourer,  1x All-in Aloe,  1x Phantomleaf, and  1x Timestalk.

Usage

[edit | edit source]

Both the Egg and Pet have the type of  Farming Pet. From level 1 until level 100, the Rose Dragon Egg has no stats nor abilities and cannot hold Pet Items.

Upon reaching level 100, a Rose Dragon Egg hatches into a Level 101 Rose Dragon Pet, skipping the 100th level. Hatching grants it stats and perks. Upon going above Level 102, each level requires the same Pet Experience as a pet going from Level 99 to Level 100.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Rose Dragon Pet is the only Dragon pet that does not increase  Magic Find.
  • As of version 0.25, the Rose Dragon Pet's abilities grant up to 180 , 89.7  and 27  Farming Fortune respectively, up to a total of 296.7  Farming Fortune, without the base 40 from its stats.
  • As with other Dragon pets, the symbiosis ability doesn't count other instances of the same Dragon pet for additional Fortune.
